libs.note: BH-9779. acl_arm (called by bin/agent-call.sh for the plan, execute, review and fix stages) resolves these once per call and sets CLAUDE_CODE_SHELL_PREFIX=bin/agent-cmd-limit.sh on the claude process, so each shell command the agent runs ends at the limit and the session goes on. Fallbacks in bin/lib/agent-cmd-limit.sh equal the defaults here (tests/agent-cmd-limit.bh-9779-test.sh K1).

knobs.note: The time limit of one shell command in a build-stage agent call. Over 1500 because bin/test-impact-gate.sh runs under timeout 1500 in a build and builders must run it (D38); 3.7x under the 6,716 s BH-7921 call.
How many last lines of a stopped command's stdout and stderr the agent gets back, after the stream. The same as SELECTION_GATE_RUN_TAIL_LINES.
After the limit, the seconds between SIGTERM and SIGKILL for the command's process group (timeout -k), and for a child the command left holding its output.
